items.title: 61125_Teddy Bunn oral history interview
items.q: Benny was rehearsing in it, so I went in there one day. He listened and he started playing. So that was when Benny said, 'You want a job?' I said, 'Okay.'

ctx.x: That's when they started all these names
about different persons, like Benny Goodman and me and others, that got a name that you hear all the time practically.
